## Player

<div class="poly" data-layers="3;2" data-sounds="hi;lo" data-bpm="60" data-edit data-presets></div>

## How to use it

- **Layers.** Each layer is a number (that many even hits per cycle) or a pattern: `x` a hit, `X` an accent, `.` a rest.
  `x.x.xx.x.x.x` is the 12-pulse bell pattern; `x..x..x...x.x...` is son clave.
- **Beat.** The tempo counts the hits of the layer marked *beat*. For a pattern it counts the pattern's main beats
  (12 pulses are four beats of three; 16 pulses four beats of four).
- **Polymeter.** Ticked, every step of every layer is the same length, so a 5-step riff against a 4-step bar drifts and
  lines up again only after 20 steps. Unticked, each layer is stretched over one cycle: a polyrhythm.
- **Mute.** Click a layer's name to mute it, then clap or play that layer yourself.

The lessons that use this player are in the **Polyrhythm** part of the Lessons sidebar, starting with
[What Is a Polyrhythm?](../lessons/poly-basics.qmd).
